title: ‘We do not ask for ayuda’: Provincial bus operators urge Marcos to lift suspension of fare hike
summary: Provincial bus operators on Tuesday urged President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to lift the suspension of fare hikes previously approved by regulators in March.
